close_reason: Delivered in PR #261 (audited 2026-09-06: retire_stalled_attempt/1 terminates the stalled attempt's sequencer/proxies/resolvers via DynamicSupervisor and demonitors; 4 real-server tests; stacked on #249, no CI run). Partial-start orphans tracked in bedrock-q67.48.
description: From the 2026-08-20 trim-batch cold audit (finding 8, pre-existing, not introduced by the trims): a recovery attempt that stalls AFTER topology unlock leaves that attempt's unlocked proxies running against that attempt's resolvers while the retry rebuilds a fresh set under the SAME epoch. Each set is internally count-consistent so the exact window relay is unaffected, but two live proxy/resolver generations sharing an epoch is a lifecycle wrinkle: the abandoned set should be torn down (or the retry should bump something the abandoned set's epoch guard rejects). Compare FDB: each recovery attempt is a fresh generation with fresh interfaces; stalled attempts die wholesale.

title: Recovery lifecycle: stalled-attempt retry leaves the abandoned attempt's unlocked proxies running in the same epoch
